text: はじめたら　やめられ　ないのさ

structure.jp: やめられ　ないのさ

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that happens. はじめたら = 'once you start'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb means 'can do', and with ない 'cannot do'. やめられ ない = 'cannot stop'.

patterns.name: 〜のさ
patterns.explanation: の explains how things are, and さ adds a cool, breezy 'that's just how it is' tone, mostly used by men. やめられ ないのさ = 'you just can't stop, you see'.
